title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end Angular, React e VUE
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Pleno/Sênior

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Pleno/Sênior apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e boas práticas, para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações modernas e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces utilizando Angular, React e Vue
  • Consumir e integrar APIs REST
  • Garantir qualidade de código com foco em testes
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura frontend
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com HTML e CSS
  • Domínio de pelo menos um framework moderno: Angular, React ou Vue
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (ES6/ES7) e TypeScript
  • Experiência com RxJS
  • Versionamento com Git
  • Vivência com AWS (diferencial)
  • Experiência com testes (ex: Testing Library)

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações frontend
  • Boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Mid-Level+ (3+ years)


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA


Descrição:


Estamos procurando um(a) Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA para ajudar clientes a levar suas aplicações com IA para escala de produção no Azure. Nessa função voltada ao cliente, você liderará engajamentos técnicos em design, construção e operações, removendo impedimentos e acelerando a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados. Como parte da equipe Cloud + AI Apps, você conduzirá engajamentos aproveitando IP Repetível e mecanismos de execução existentes, com responsabilidade por excelência na entrega, crescimento de consumo e implantação bem-sucedida para o cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Interagir com líderes de TI e de negócios do cliente para entender as prioridades de aplicações, dados e IA, e desenhar soluções seguras e escaláveis que gerem valor de negócio e satisfação do cliente.
  • Estar credenciado(a) e certificado(a) para entregar com proficiência avançada e de nível especialista em cargas de trabalho prioritárias, incluindo Azure AI Foundry, AKS, App Service, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, APIM e GitHub.
  • Liderar engajamentos técnicos em design de arquitetura, Provas de Conceito (POCs) e Produtos Mínimos Viáveis (MVPs) para acelerar a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados.
  • Ser responsável pelos resultados de entrega técnica ponta a ponta, garantindo completude e precisão dos planos de consumo e de sucesso do cliente em colaboração com o CSAM.
  • Conduzir as próximas melhores ações e gerar pipeline incremental a partir de cada engajamento, alinhando-se às prioridades do Unified Enterprise Support (ES).
  • Entregar propriedade intelectual (IP) reutilizável e contribuir para o desenvolvimento centralizado de IP para acelerar a implantação e alcançar os resultados-alvo.
  • Fornecer supervisão de entrega e suporte a escalonamentos (escalation) para engajamentos-chave de Factory em projetos de IA e de Inovação em Apps.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente, compartilhando insights e feedback com as equipes de engenharia para influenciar melhorias de produto e remover impedimentos à adoção.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências do cliente por meio de workshops técnicos, atividades de readiness e recomendações que garantam desempenho, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade da solução.
  • Manter profunda expertise técnica e permanecer atualizado(a) sobre tendências de desenvolvimento no Azure, IA, GitHub e cloud-native, contribuindo também para comunidades técnicas internas e externas.


Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens exporaticas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.
  • Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs.
  • Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits.
  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
  • Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness.
  • Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms.
  • Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines.
  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Desenvolvedor Java SR
description:
Código da vaga: 59215


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 7 anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot para desenvolvimento backend;

- Vivência em cloud Amazon Web Services com serviços como EKS, S3, Lambda e API Gateway;

- Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e construção de APIs REST escaláveis;

- Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) para provisionamento e automação de ambientes;

- Prática com CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions;

- Experiência com ferramentas de IA;

- Conhecimento em Terraform;

- Foco em boas práticas de engenharia (Clean Code, testes automatizados, observabilidade e segurança).


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator.


Key Responsibilities


Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
  • Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc

System Operations

  • Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
  • Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) issues
  • Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts
  • Webhosting experience (cPanel, Exim, MySQL)
  • Windows Hosting experience (IIS, DNS , Mailenable)


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on Systems Administration
  • Strong understanding of Linux/Windows servers, DNS, WebServers,
  • Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDoS mitigation
  • Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL
  • Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Experience

  • 4+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
  • Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Wellhub and Telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.
  • Merit and promotion annual cycle.


And muuuuuuch more!

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Esse vaga precisa de inglês Avançado . VAGA COM INGLÊS FLUENTE Engenheiro de dados Gestão de estruturas de dados, definição de modelos e padrões logidos de dados como unica fonte de informação (data lake com governança de dados ); Experiencia em arquitetura de Dados; Desenvolvimento Python; Experiencia em coleta, transformação e carga de dados (ferramentas de ETL ); Experiência em trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados; Modelagem de Banco de Dados (SQL, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, ); Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB ); Integração de dados com outros sistemas Plataforma AWS; Experiência em workloads de missão crítica; Containers (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, EKS Openshift); DevOps (Gitlab; Gitlab CI, Puppet); Cloudformation (Code Build, CodePipeline) Softwares Necessários: API Gateway . Kafka . AWS Lake Formation . AWS Banco de Dados (Redshift, MySQL, Dynam DB,..) . AWS Athena . AWS GLUE ( Crawlers, Jobs, workflow) . AWS Quick Sigth . AWS EMR . AWS Lambda.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Gympass;

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
